versions.content: {DRAFT} Definition of LIN message transport in IEEE1722Tp ACF stream Each LIN message to be transported on an IEEE1722Tp ACF stream is defined by having a dedicated IEEE1722TpAcfLinPart and referring from that IEEE1722TpAcfLinPart to a PduTriggering in the role sdu . This PduTrig- gering defines which Pdu shall be transported via the iPdu reference.
